description: Up to eight Brazilian companies for a CNPJ, name, partner, phone or e-mail. It detects the kind of input, joins the names and removes duplicates. Text needs at least three characters and matches the legal name, the trade name and the partners; exact names come before prefixes, without repeating a CNPJ. A phone needs the area code; an e-mail needs the full address on record. `incompleto: true` means one of the sources failed. Suggestions include no contacts and no personal names. Not cached and not counted as a visit in the metrics.

q.description: A valid CNPJ, a phone with area code, a full e-mail or a text of 3 to 120 characters.

name: suggest
title: Suggest companies
